create_vector_env: create a VectorEnv with multiple parallel Habitat environments using forkserver multiprocessing
step_vector_env: step all vectorized environments in parallel with a list of actions for each env
reset_vector_env: reset all vectorized environments and return observations from each environment
create_threaded_vector_env: create a ThreadedVectorEnv that runs parallel environments in threads for easier debugging
call_vector_env_function: call an arbitrary function or retrieve a property on a specific vectorized environment by index
